source.authors: Volodymyr Zhuk, Lesya Vovk, Ihor Popadiuk and Ivan Matlai
source.paper: Experimental surface runoff hydrographs from linear impervious subcatchments for rainfalls of extremely high intensity
source.observationsLocation: Figure 2, black cumulative runoff volume trace only
source.observationNotes: Numerical facts transcribed from the published plot. The article's underlying digital mass series is available on request. The 30 s observation is obscured by the orange curve and is omitted. No plot asset is redistributed.
source.manningProvenance: Section 2.2 reports a mean measured Manning coefficient of 0.009 ± 0.0003 for the flume. The measurement procedure and any overlap with Figure 2 runoff are unspecified. The diagnostic uses the published coefficient as given, without fitting it, and cannot establish that it was measured independently of the scored runoff.
source.initialDepthProvenance: The model starts with zero free water, consistent with the Figure 2 retention curve at the start of rainfall. The article does not report a separate prewetting or residual film measurement.
